shortDescription: This module manages mirrored volumes on IBM Storage Virtualize family systems

options.name: clustername
options.description: The hostname or management IP of the Storage Virtualize system.

options.name: compressed
options.description: Specifies if the volume to be created is compressed.

options.name: deduplicated
options.description: Specifies if the volume to be created is deduplicated.

options.name: domain
options.description: Domain for the Storage Virtualize system. Valid when hostname is used for the parameter I(clustername).

options.name: grainsize
options.description: Specifies the grain size (in KB) to use when creating the HyperSwap volume.

options.name: name
options.description: Specifies the name/UID to assign to the new volume.

options.name: password
options.description: REST API password for the Storage Virtualize system. The parameters I(username) and I(password) are required if not using I(token) to authenticate a user.

options.name: poolA
options.description: Specifies the name of first storage pool to be used when creating a mirrored volume.

options.name: poolB
options.description: Specifies the name of second storage pool to be used when creating a mirrored volume.

options.name: rsize
options.description: Specifies the rsize (buffersize) in %. Defines how much physical space is initially allocated to the thin-provisioned or compressed volume.

options.name: size
options.description: Specifies the size of mirrored volume in MB. This can also be used to resize a mirrored volume. When resizing, only mandatory parameters can be passed.

options.name: state
options.description: Creates (C(present)) or removes (C(absent)) a mirrored volume.

options.name: thin
options.description: Specifies if the volume to be created is thin-provisioned.

options.name: token
options.description: The authentication token to verify a user on the Storage Virtualize system. To generate a token, use the ibm_svc_auth module.

options.name: type
options.description: Specifies the desired volume type. When the type is C(local hyperswap), a HyperSwap volume gets created. When the type is C(standard) and values for I(PoolA) and I(PoolB) arguments are also specified, a "standard mirror" volume gets created. If a "standard" mirrored volume exists and either I(PoolA) or I(PoolB) is specified, the mirrored volume gets converted to a standard volume.

options.name: username
options.description: REST API username for the Storage Virtualize system. The parameters I(username) and I(password) are required if not using I(token) to authenticate a user.
